scenarios.stage_semantics: independent snapshots; NOT a continuous runnable schedule

reasons: AP physical IO has no qualified whole-lifecycle ownership/cache-state coverage
TP physical requests/transaction are a native-publication proxy, not exact event attribution
TP-only cache paths do not yet model AP-induced OS-page-cache eviction
AP CPU/wall bridge includes extrapolation and whole-query averages, not stage operator phases
structural reservations are not measured concurrent native operator grants/physical peaks

TP128.nonidentifiability: constant P_disk: L_other + A*C_SB + A*P_disk*(C_disk-C_SB) is a single intercept; beta_OS = A*(C_OS-C_SB)

S5_128_plus_16.nonidentifiability: constant P_disk: L_other + A*C_SB + A*P_disk*(C_disk-C_SB) is a single intercept; beta_OS = A*(C_OS-C_SB)

device_model.method: measured IOPS/bandwidth caps; not a complete 4-class 2D fio surface

PPT_contract.1_cache_paths: step1 P_SB/P_OS/P_disk -> fitted identifiable TP-only path response
PPT_contract.2_AP_work: step2 exact-WM blind operator work/logical R+W -> CPU/wall/physical proxy
PPT_contract.3_shared_resources: preserved step3 WMs -> finite AP average rates -> CPU/media closure
PPT_contract.4_queue_and_latency: IOPS * (measured floor + common-cap wait); not complete fio surface
PPT_contract.5_TPS: N / (fitted cache-path baseline + incremental CPU wait + incremental IO wait)
